args.body:
- Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, widening the gap between spot and contract pricing.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, adding near-term volatility to landed freight costs.
- Companion analysis: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least, suggesting a multi-carrier strategy as the cost-optimal approach.
args.title: Bellwether Freight Pricing — Combined Summary (2026)
